steps.caption: The Schedule
steps.narration: The Schedule can show a month, a week, or a list. Here is how to switch.

steps.caption: Month view
steps.narration: It opens on Month. Every visit sits on its day.

steps.caption: Next month
steps.narration: The arrows move one month forward or back.

steps.caption: Today
steps.narration: Today brings you back to this month.

steps.caption: Week
steps.narration: Choose Week to see seven days side by side.

steps.caption: A visit in the week
steps.narration: Each visit shows its start time and its title.

steps.caption: Next week
steps.narration: Here the arrows move a week at a time.

steps.caption: Today
steps.narration: And Today comes back to this week.

steps.caption: Agenda
steps.narration: Choose Agenda for a list of what is coming, day by day.

steps.caption: A visit in the list
steps.narration: Each visit shows its time, its project and the crew.

steps.caption: 7d, 14d, 30d
steps.narration: These buttons set how far ahead the list looks: 7, 14 or 30 days.

steps.caption: Whose calendar
steps.narration: This list chooses whose calendar you see. It starts on My calendar.

steps.caption: Marco Delgado
steps.narration: Pick a name to see one person's visits. We'll choose Marco Delgado.

steps.caption: Marco's visits
steps.narration: Now the list is the visits Marco booked or is going to.

steps.caption: Back to Month
steps.narration: The same choice applies in Month and Week.

steps.caption: Menu: Schedule
steps.narration: You'll find Schedule in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to switch month, week and agenda views | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the three Schedule views in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will move between months and weeks, jump back to today, read the agenda list for the next 7, 14 or 30 days, and look at one team member's calendar.
